title: Rebuild comments/feedback website with working button interactions and navigation

requirements.summary: Implement comment list management system with create and add entry functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create new comment lists with custom titles
Users can add individual comment entries to existing lists
Lists and comments persist across sessions

file_operations.description: Ensure the create list functionality and add comment operations work correctly. Verify that the form submissions trigger backend calls using useAdminComments hooks. Ensure proper error handling and success feedback with toast notifications. Make sure all button click handlers are properly bound and functional.

Review and ensure all mutation hooks (useCreateCommentList, useAddComment, useBulkAddComments) properly invalidate queries after successful operations. Verify error handling is in place for all backend calls.

requirements.summary: Create admin panel with lock/unlock controls for comment list management
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel displays all comment lists with their lock status
Admin can toggle lock/unlock status for each list
Lock status changes persist and are reflected immediately in the UI

file_operations.description: Ensure the lock/unlock toggle button functionality works correctly. Verify that clicking the lock button calls the useLockUnlockList mutation and updates the UI immediately. Add optimistic updates if needed for better UX. Ensure proper visual indicators for locked vs unlocked states.
Verify the useLockUnlockList hook properly calls toggleLockList backend capability and invalidates the relevant queries to refresh lock status in the UI.

requirements.summary: Implement Internet Identity authentication for admin access control
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel is protected by Internet Identity authentication
Unauthenticated users cannot access admin features
Login flow integrates smoothly with the application

file_operations.description: Replace the current token-based authentication with Internet Identity authentication using the authorization component. Use useInternetIdentity hook to check authentication status. Verify the user's admin role by calling isCallerAdmin() before granting access. Display appropriate loading states during authentication checks and access denied messages for non-admin users. Verify the component's usage instructions from the authorization component before implementing.

Create a login/logout button component following the authorization component's usage instructions. Implement authentication flow using useInternetIdentity hook with proper state handling for login/logout transitions. Include query client clearing on logout. Add visual feedback for disabled/loading states. Verify the component's usage instructions from the authorization component before implementing.

Add the LoginButton component to the navigation bar. Update admin panel visibility logic to check Internet Identity authentication state and admin role instead of token-based authentication. Ensure smooth integration with existing navigation structure.
Remove the token-based authentication hook as it will be replaced by Internet Identity and role-based access control from the authorization component.

Create a modal component for first-time user profile setup following the authorization component's user profile setup guidelines. Display when user is authenticated but has no profile (getCallerUserProfile returns null). Include a form to collect the user's name and call saveCallerUserProfile on submission. Implement proper loading state handling to prevent modal flash during initial load. Verify the component's usage instructions from the authorization component before implementing.

Create React Query hooks for user profile management including useGetCallerUserProfile, useSaveCallerUserProfile. Implement the prevention of profile setup modal flash as described in the authorization component's usage instructions. Ensure proper actor dependency handling and query state management. Verify the component's usage instructions from the authorization component before implementing.

Integrate the ProfileSetupModal component into the layout. Show the modal when user is authenticated, profile loading is complete, and no profile exists. Ensure the modal appears above all other content and blocks interaction until profile is set up.

requirements.summary: Fix navigation flow to automatically navigate to entry form after creating a new list
acceptanceCriteria: After creating a new list, user is automatically taken to the entry form
Navigation transition is smooth and immediate
User can begin adding entries without additional clicks

file_operations.description: Update the create list success handler to automatically expand/focus the newly created list's entry form section. Implement smooth scrolling to the list's comment input area after creation. Ensure the list name input clears and the new list appears immediately in the UI with its add comment form ready for input.

requirements.summary: Ensure all button interactions work correctly in live deployment
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons trigger their associated functions when clicked
No buttons are unresponsive or require multiple clicks

file_operations.description: Review all button click handlers to ensure they are properly bound and prevent default form submission where needed. Add loading states to all action buttons using mutation isPending states. Disable buttons during operations to prevent duplicate submissions. Ensure all forms use onSubmit handlers with e.preventDefault().
Review delete button handlers to ensure proper binding and loading states. Add confirmation dialogs for destructive actions. Disable buttons during deletion operations.
Verify message submission button functionality with proper loading and disabled states. Ensure form submission clears inputs after successful message send.
Review all CRUD operation buttons for live list apps and usernames. Ensure proper loading states and disabled states during operations. Verify bulk operations handle large inputs correctly.
Verify access key management button handlers work correctly with proper loading and confirmation states. Ensure dialogs close properly after operations complete.

Review comment generation button functionality. Ensure proper loading states during generation. Verify device ID tracking works correctly for single-use restrictions. Add visual feedback for successful comment generation.
Verify check button functionality with proper loading states. Ensure results display correctly and CSV export button works. Add feedback for empty results or errors.
Verify upload button functionality with progress tracking. Ensure ExternalBlob upload progress callbacks work correctly. Add proper success/error feedback after upload completion.

requirements.summary: Apply cohesive visual design with professional modern aesthetic using warm neutral tones
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette uses warm neutrals with subtle accents
Typography is clean and readable across all components
Layout maintains consistent spacing and visual hierarchy
Design feels professional and suitable for a feedback management tool

file_operations.description: Update the color system to use warm neutral tones throughout. Replace current color variables with warm beige/sand backgrounds, warm gray text colors, and subtle amber/brown accents. Ensure good contrast ratios for accessibility. Update both light and dark mode color schemes to maintain the warm aesthetic. Keep existing utility classes for cards and buttons but update their color references.

Update the Tailwind configuration to extend the theme with warm neutral color palette. Configure primary colors as warm browns/ambers, secondary as warm grays, and accent as subtle gold/bronze. Ensure typography settings promote clean readable fonts with appropriate line heights and letter spacing.

Update the layout styling to use warm neutral background colors instead of the current background image. Apply consistent padding and spacing. Ensure the footer uses warm neutral tones consistent with the new palette. Update navigation bar styling to match the new aesthetic.

Update navigation button styles to use warm neutral colors with subtle hover effects. Ensure active/selected states are visually clear. Apply consistent spacing and sizing that aligns with professional design standards.

Apply consistent styling with warm neutral colors to all form inputs, buttons, and content cards. Ensure proper spacing between list items and sections. Update button colors to use warm accent tones. Apply subtle shadows and borders for depth.
Update the image grid layout with warm neutral borders and backgrounds. Ensure consistent card styling with subtle shadows. Apply proper spacing in the grid layout.
Style the chat interface with warm neutral message bubbles and backgrounds. Ensure clear visual hierarchy between sender names, messages, and timestamps. Apply consistent form styling.
Update all form sections and app cards with warm neutral styling. Ensure consistent button and input styles. Apply proper spacing and visual grouping.
Apply warm neutral card styling to settings sections. Ensure buttons and form elements match the overall design system.
Update the admin panel container and tab styling with warm neutral colors. Ensure the Shield icon branding complements the new color scheme. Apply consistent padding and spacing throughout.
Style the customer view with warm neutral tones. Ensure form elements, select dropdowns, and result displays use consistent styling. Apply clear visual hierarchy for different sections.
Update the checker interface with warm neutral styling. Ensure input areas, result tables, and action buttons follow the design system. Apply proper spacing and grouping.
Style the upload interface with warm neutral tones. Ensure the upload area, progress indicators, and success messages match the overall design aesthetic.
